subject: general
question:
The [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] represents a set of calculations that are common across all the given equations. Identify the calculations involved and solve the third equation on the same basis:

4 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] 3 = 16; 9; 25

6 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] 2 = 36; 4; 40

7 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] 4 = ?; ?; ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

4 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] 3 = 16; 9; 25

4² = 16; 3² = 9; (16 + 9) = 25 ⇒ 16; 9; 25

And,

6 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] 2 = 36; 4; 40

62 = 36; 22 = 4; (36 + 4) = 40 ⇒ 36; 4; 40

Similarly,

7 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0860f28da8cac81bbed9a51904c167f5bc1ef0d2a72576801929b614a69da01.png] 4 = ?; ?; ?

72 = 49; 42 = 16; (49 + 16) = 65 ⇒** 49****; 16; 65**

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
